instruction: Locate and access the list of Antitrust Division forms.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from justice.gov homepage to the Antitrust Division forms page (component ID 401). Similar navigation pattern to original task, different division target. Evaluator verifies URL contains the Antitrust Division forms query parameter.
metadata.verification_method: URL pattern matching using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric. The pattern checks for forms page with Antitrust Division component ID (401).

Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies the end state (correct forms page is opened) which fully satisfies the instruction requirement
No runtime issues: getter can access URL state from accessibility tree, metric can perform regex matching, and no postconfig is needed since URL state persists after navigation
